claim_ceiling: The exact Cursor application and embedded MCP extension completed one owner-assisted registered-project mem_current_project call after the owner enabled the project MCP server. This establishes only that one fixed-project workspace case; it does not establish general Cursor support.
limitations: The exact tool-call execution timestamp was not retained; recorded_at is the later evidence-capture time on the same date.
The Cursor application and embedded MCP extension identities were captured from the installed application immediately after the session; their files predated the session.
The project MCP server was initially disabled and required explicit owner enablement before the call.
The project-local configuration supplied the expected registered project explicitly; this observation does not establish dynamic project discovery.
No model-provider, account, subscription, or credential state was inspected or inferred.
No memory content was read or saved; memory read/write correctness was not tested.

Unregistered, missing-remote, explicit-mismatch, registry-collision, provider-unavailable, multi-project, clean-profile, credential-isolation, instruction-lifecycle, restart, and other-platform cases remain unrun.
The post-response probes are point-in-time evidence and do not establish crash, force-quit, or universal lifecycle behavior.
